title: WCAG 1.4.1 color-only information second cues
statement:
WCAG 1.4.1 (Level A) requires that color is not the only visual means of conveying information, indicating an action, prompting a response or distinguishing an element, so links in body text, error and required-field states and status badges need a second cue such as an underline, icon or text.

Options:
- Underlined or cued links: Underlined links in running text; if links are not underlined, give them at least 3:1 contrast with surrounding text plus an added cue on hover and focus (WCAG technique G183) (fits: clear, trustworthy, editorial)
- Errors beyond red: Error states shown with a red border plus an error icon and message text (fits: friendly, clear, professional)
- Required-field marker: Required fields marked with an asterisk or the word 'required' in addition to any color (fits: practical, clear, corporate)
- Labelled badges: Plan or status badges that carry a text label or icon (for example a 'Popular' tag) rather than a colored ring alone (fits: modern, saas, clear)
- Non-color chart cues: Charts and legends with direct labels, patterns or marker shapes in addition to color (fits: data-driven, technical, analytical)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web. Audience: general.
